model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different language models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European (IE) language families, as well as on Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic languages. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis lists the language families. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different language model, with the colors being light blue for mBERT-L2, dark blue for XLM-L2, green for mBERT-R2, light green for XLM-R2, red for mBERT-B2, and dark red for XLM-B2. The bars vary in height, indicating the magnitude of the effect, with error bars suggesting variability or confidence intervals. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
